subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should maintainers sponsor a repaired version of this outbound serializer PR, or leave it waiting on the contributor to rebase and address the blocking findings?
rationale: The user-visible bug is proven, but the open draft is merge-conflicting and needs non-trivial owner-boundary repair before it becomes a safe landing candidate.

options.title: Repair Before Merge
options.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lanes before queue/platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh Telegram proof.

options.title: Wait For Author
options.body: Keep the PR open as a contributor draft until the author rebases and addresses the existing findings.

options.title: Close If Maintainers Decline Ownership
options.body: If maintainers do not want to sponsor this branch and the author remains inactive, close later with the proven bug preserved in a narrower issue or replacement PR.

recommendation.title: Repair Before Merge
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lanes before queue/platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current-main rewrite touching the relevant outbound and keyed queue lines, so they are the best current routing candidate for the repair-vs-wait choice.
